records.title: Director of Operations - Proliant Dairy Ingredients - Ankeny, Iowa
records.description:
Proliant Dairy Ingredients is committed to providing the best dairy ingredient options for enhancing the value and effectiveness of our partners’ products. We are formulating success by living our values of Continuous Improvement, Teamwork, Quality, and Leadership. 
 
The Director of Operations provides strategic leadership and oversight of the company’s manufacturing operations, quality, and process engineering functions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and supporting overall organizational performance and growth. As a member of the PDI leadership team, this position works closely with the CEO and senior leadership to drive business growth, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS:**
-----------------------

Education:

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* BS or MBA in operations management, engineering, or dairy and/or food science preferred.

 

Experience:

* Demonstrated leadership ability with strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
* Minimum eight years of experience required, with at least five years of production/operations management experience.
* Experience within dairy industry or food processing highly preferred.

**JOB DUTIES:**
---------------

* Lead the development and implementation of operational strategies, policies, and processes to drive efficiency and organizational effectiveness within manufacturing operations.
* Lead and oversee all aspects of employee management for the operations, quality, and process engineering departments, including recruiting, hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, employee development, recognition, and discipline. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate market opportunities and develop recommendations to drive business development and company growth.
* Support raw material sourcing strategies, assist in securing reliable supply commitments, and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure supply continuity and alignment with business objectives.
* Oversee workplace safety across all PDI U.S. production facilities, ensuring safe working conditions are maintained, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented when necessary.
* Responsible for overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of U.S. production facilities. Keep up to date on dairy processes and techniques.
* Interact, visit, and communicate with various vendors regarding necessary changes to improve operations at all plants.
* Identify areas for improvement in the plants, determine courses of action, and implement improvements and corrective actions in these areas.
* Develop plans for supply and efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Review production costs and product quality, maximize yields, modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of all U.S. Operations.
* Research and assess the viability of new technologies to improve operations.
* Participate in strategic planning process by reviewing PDI operations and recommend budgets for both raw material and capital expenditures.
* Submit necessary requests for capital investment in accordance with established budgets, process, and return-on-investment requirements; present capital investment projects to President & CEO and as necessary to the PDI leadership team.
* Ensures fundamental food safety and quality practices are maintained to achieve food safety and quality objectives and supports ongoing improvements of food safety programs.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**
---------------------

* Knowledge of manufacturing, engineering, and operations principles and ability to apply those principles to production management function.
* Ability to effectively communicate and work with management and across multiple departments, as well as with customers and other business contacts.
* Ability to maintain and manage corporate confidential information as well as confidential customer information.
* Knowledge of organizational methods and the ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously.
* Ability to assist with special or ongoing projects as instructed by senior management.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional journals, technical procedures, or government guidelines.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from internal individuals/groups, suppliers, customers, and the public.
* Ability to analyze data and utilize to drive optimization and problem solving.
* Strong leadership ability in creating a team environment.
* Ability to think strategically and at the same time solve practical problems across a variety of situations.
* Ability to travel as needed to meet job duties (approximately 50%).

**BASIC PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
--------------------------------

Approximate: 8 - Hour Day (may be longer, dependent on business needs)

**BASIC MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:**
------------------------------

This position requires the mental capabilities to apply technical knowledge surrounding the production and operation of manufacturing plants. Furthermore, the incumbent must assimilate and disseminate operational information, develop plans, and forecast future supply and production trends.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND EXPOSURES:**
-------------------------------------

Position located in Iowa. Occasional travel (international and domestic) to include spending time in two production plants and laboratory locations (Michigan and Minnesota) and headquarters in Iowa.

**COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS:**

* A choice of three quality affordable healthcare coverage options
* Vision coverage
* Dental coverage
* Health savings account with employer contribution/flexible spending accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off starting at 3 week/annual and 9 paid holidays

records.title: Senior Director, Merchandise Manufacturing & Sourcing
records.description:
**Job Description:**
====================

NOTE: This role is based in New York City and encourages a minimum of two days per week in the SoHo office. Some roles or teams may require additional in-office attendance if the essential functions of the role require it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Director, Merchandise Manufacturing & Strategic Sourcing is a key global leadership role responsible for the strategic sourcing, manufacturing, commercialization, and production execution of Scholastic's merchandise portfolio supporting Book Fairs, Book Clubs, Trade Publishing, Discovery Fairs, and future consumer product initiatives.

Reporting directly to the SVP Manufacturing who is responsible for Global Supply Chain and Procurement, this position serves as the critical bridge between Product Development, Editorial, Design, Category Management, Publishing, and global manufacturing partners.

This leader partners with internal stakeholders from the earliest stages of product ideation, providing expertise in product engineering, sourcing strategy, manufacturing capabilities, material selection, cost optimization, and production feasibility. The objective is to transform creative concepts into high-quality, innovative products that deliver exceptional customer experiences while achieving aggressive cost, quality, and speed-to-market objectives.

The role oversees a global sourcing portfolio exceeding $200 million annually and leads an international team of approximately 12 professionals located across the United States and India. The position may be based in the United States, China, or India and requires extensive collaboration with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturing partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

**Product Development, Ideation & Publishing Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic partner to Publishing, Editorial, Design, Category Management, Book Fairs, Book Clubs, Trade, and other stakeholders to translate creative concepts and intellectual property into compelling, manufacturable products.
* Engage early in product ideation, bringing manufacturing and sourcing expertise to decisions around materials, formats, construction, packaging, features, price points, and production methods.
* Proactively introduce new product concepts, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and supplier innovations that expand Scholastic's product opportunities.
* Partner throughout the development cycle from concept, specification, prototyping, sampling, and costing through pproval and production.
* Challenge and improve concepts where appropriate to enhance consumer appeal, quality, manufacturability, sustainability, speed, and cost.

**Consumer Products & Sourcing Strategy**

* Lead development of the sourcing and manufacturing strategy supporting Scholastic's expanding consumer-products and merchandise initiatives.
* Partner with business and publishing leadership to identify new product categories and opportunities across Book Fairs, Discovery Fairs, retail, e-commerce, licensing, and other emerging channels.
* Develop category sourcing strategies addressing manufacturing regions, supplier capabilities, cost, lead times, minimum quantities, tooling, quality, and supply-chain risk.
* Build a proactive pipeline of product ideas and manufacturing capabilities that can be regularly presented to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of consumer trends, emerging categories, materials, and manufacturing technologies and translate those insights into actionable product opportunities.

**Global Vendor Development & Innovation**

* Proactively identify and develop innovative manufacturers and product-development partners, particularly those offering engineering expertise, rapid prototyping, unique materials, creative capabilities, and new manufacturing technologies.
* Develop suppliers that can function as extensions of Scholastic's product-development organization, proactively bringing forward new concepts and capabilities.
* Continuously evaluate the supplier portfolio to improve competitiveness, increase speed, diversify supply, reduce risk, and enable entry into new categories.

**Global Sourcing, Cost & Operational Leadership**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive global sourcing strategy supporting more than $200 million in annual product expense.
* Establish sourcing roadmaps and supplier-diversification strategies that anticipate future business requirements and reduce dependency on individual suppliers or regions.
* Ensure products consistently meet expectations for quality, safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, cost, and on-time delivery.

**Supplier Engagement & Global Travel**

* Maintain direct senior-level engagement with strategic manufacturing partners and regularly visit supplier facilities to evaluate capabilities, innovation, quality, capacity, and operational performance.
* Significant international travel is expected, with consistent travel to Asia, particularly China and India, as well as other global sourcing markets as required.
* Use supplier visits as product-development and innovation opportunities to identify new materials, manufacturing processes, capabilities, and product concepts for Scholastic.
* Participate in relevant trade shows, sourcing events, and supplier innovation sessions to identify emerging capabilities and potential partners.

**Organizational Leadership**

* Lead and develop a global organization of approximately 12 professionals across the United States and India.
* Build a culture combining sourcing discipline with creativity, product knowledge, commercial thinking, and an entrepreneurial approach to product development.
* Develop team capabilities in product ideation, product development, supplier innovation, value engineering, and strategic sourcing.
* Build strong partnerships across Publishing, Editorial, Design, Category Management, Supply Chain, Finance, and senior leadership, positioning the organization as a strategic product-development partner.

**Key Measures of Success**

Success will be measured through product development and innovation, cost per unit and total landed-cost, speed to market, supplier innovation and diversification, quality and compliance, on-time performance.

**About Scholastic**

For more than 100 years, Scholastic Corporation (NASDAQ: SCHL) has been meeting children where they are – at school, at home and in their communities – by creating quality content and experiences, all beginning with literacy. Scholastic delivers stories, characters, and learning moments that empower all kids to become lifelong readers and learners through bestselling children’s books, literacy- and knowledge-building resources for schools including classroom magazines, and award-winning, entertaining children's media. As the world's largest publisher and distributor of children's books through school-based book clubs and book fairs, classroom libraries, school and public libraries, retail, and online, and with a global reach into more than 135 countries, Scholastic encourages the personal and intellectual growth of all children, while nurturing a lifelong relationship with reading, themselves, and the world around them. Learn more at www.scholastic.com.

Some benefits that we offer:

 

* Full suite of health and wellness benefits (including a $0 deductible Medical Plan)
* Retirement Savings Plan 401(k) with options for both Roth and Traditional Contributions
* Tuition-Free programs for undergraduate and graduate degrees
* Generous Parental Leave Program
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with opportunity for discounted stock at a 15% discount

Thank you for your consideration in choosing Scholastic.

A minimum of 10 years of experience as a valued member of a non-book/novelty/ merchandise development team. Proven track record working at a well established company representing a diverse product catalog consisting of products attractive to consumer interest and educationaly directed.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Location:

Garden City, NY, US, 11530

Business Unit: Treitler FMH

Posting Date: Nov 20, 2026

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for leading Hughes-Treitler operations to achieve business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This hands-on leadership role provides strategic and day-to-day direction for manufacturing, materials, and operational excellence while ensuring the organization has the talent, capacity, processes, and resources required to support current demand and business growth. The Director establishes operating plans, drives accountability, builds organizational capability, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance, expand capacity, control costs, and strengthen customer responsiveness.

 
 

**Supervisory Responsibilties:**

The position has direct reports but must be able to work in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Production in support of the departmental objectives. 



**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop Operations teams to effectively support day-to-day execution, strategic business objectives, customer requirements, and growth plans.
* Establish operating strategies, objectives, budgets, capital requirements, material plans, labor requirements, and organizational priorities aligned with customer and business needs.
* Ensure the organization is structured and staffed with the talent, resources, and capabilities needed to meet customer quality, technical, delivery, and turnaround-time expectations.
* Partner with business leadership to achieve key performance indicators, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, throughput, backlog reduction, customer lead time, productivity, labor utilization, cost, and profitability.
* Lead the development and execution of the site Lean and Operational Excellence roadmap, using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, TPM, SIOP and daily management practices to improve flow, yield, cycle time, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and monitor operating standards, performance metrics, and management routines that drive accountability, timely problem-solving, and sustained results.
* Drive capacity planning and expansion initiatives, including capital equipment, automation, facility, tooling, staffing, and process investments required to support business growth.
* Manage operating expenses and capital investments in accordance with approved budgets; identify and execute cost-reduction and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure effective planning and control of materials, inventory, suppliers, production schedules, and labor resources to support quality, cost, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to resolve operational issues, support new product introductions, strengthen manufacturability, and meet customer requirements.
* Provide leadership for robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer performance.
* Participate in the development and execution of the business strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable operating plans and measurable objectives.
* Support commercial and customer-facing activities, including operational reviews, pricing and capacity analyses, customer visits, and performance presentations.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain operations talent through performance management, career development, succession planning, cross-training, and ongoing capability building.
* Foster a culture of accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Author annual performance reviews and develop continuing education and advancement paths for entire department.
* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost performance, including identifying suitable use cases and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs.
 

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to establish performance metrics, analyze operating data, prioritize competing demands, and drive accountability for results.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective work relationships.
* Strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to balance customer requirements with operational, financial, and organizational priorities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a hands-on leadership presence across the operation.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and manufacturing systems; experience with SIOP or related planning processes preferred.
* Demonstrated history of successful change management and implementation of operational excellence improvements.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization from the production floor to the executive office.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed to support business requirements.
 

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or another related technical discipline required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience in a low-volume/high-mix, build-to-order, or engineered-products environment; experience in aerospace, defense, metal-forming, precision machining, brazing, welding, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading salaried and hourly employees.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement programs with measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational planning, capital and capacity expansion, production and materials management, cost optimization, organizational improvements, and customer-facing operational reviews.

**Other**

* Due to the nature of Hughes-Treitler's programs and products, applicants must have the legal right to work in the US and additionally must be legally authorized to access export-controlled information and source code.

**Physical Requirements:**

* None

**Compensation**
----------------

Employee Type: Salaried

Currency: USD

Salary Minimum: 200,000

Salary Maximum: 225,000

Incentive: No

Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Description:

**Join Weiss-Aug – A Leader in Precision Manufacturing and Innovation**

Be part of a company that’s shaping the future of manufacturing where your ideas, skills, and passion matter.

Weiss-Aug, is a leading provider of advanced manufacturing and engineering solutions with advanced facilities across the U.S. and Mexico for over 50 years.

**Why Join Us?**

At Weiss-Aug we are driven by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. As a recognized leader in the industrial and commercial sectors, specializing in high-volume metal stamping, thermoplastic molding, and value-added assembly solutions for the medical, aerospace & defense, automotive, interconnect, telecommunications and consumer goods industries, we take pride in cultivating a collaborative and forward-thinking work environment.

We're currently seeking a passionate and skilled ***Director of Operations*** to join our team and contribute to our mission of delivering high-quality, engineered solutions to our customers worldwide. In this role you will be responsible for planning and directing line management and related manufacturing support activities including manufacturing floor inspection, manufacturing engineering, materials management and safety/environmental engineering. Establishes and implements manufacturing policies, controls and procedures to further the company's interest in efficiently producing quality products. Contributes to achievement of sales objectives and to the establishment. Prepares or assists in the annual budgets for all departments and is responsible for profit and loss of the division. Manages Manufacturing Managers of Molding and Stamping, Purchasing, Warehouse, Manufacturing Engineering, Customer Service/Planning.

**Responsibilities**

* Management of manufacturing operations. Plans, schedules, organizes, and staffs manufacturing and manufacturing support functions. Assures that all groups within manufacturing organization are properly staffed and coordinated; and that personnel in each group are properly qualified, directed and trained to perform their duties effectively.
* Interprets company sales forecasts and shop orders and establishes accurate manufacturing plans to assure that our customers' requirements are met, that is, defect free product on time.
* Coordinates with Engineering, Sales and new product development engineering to maintain an awareness of current and future product plans.
* Develops and manages material control, manufacturing control, production scheduling, and planning systems to assure achievement of output schedules which will meet company sales requirements.
* Maintains material and parts inventories which are adequate to ensure the fulfillment of production schedules with minimum inventory expense.
* Plans and develops manufacturing facilities and equipment for efficient production of products.
* Works with tooling/engineering to investigate product quality and manufacturing problems and determine the most cost-efficient solutions.
* Develops and assists with the annual budget of all departments; develops and is responsible for all standard costs. Recommends pricing based on the profit objective of the company. Is responsible for the profit and loss of the division.
* Meets or exceeds all TQM measurements as agreed upon annually.
* Is a member of the executive team and steering team which are responsible for the development of company policies and plans.
* Participates with other top managers in the development of company business policies as needed.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.
* 8-10 years precision manufacturing experience including some experience in molding. (10 years in management role).
* Strong leadership skills.
* Should have a working knowledge of computerized manufacturing systems.

This position is at our ***East Hanover, NJ*** location.

Pay Range: $150,000 - $180,000

**Other Benefits Include**

* Medical, Dental and Vision
* 401 (k) with company match
* Holiday, Vacation and Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Cigna Wellness Incentive Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Short Term Disability
* Group Life and Accidental Insurance
* Sun Life – Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
* Smoking Cessation Program
* Pet Insurance

**US Pay Transparency**

The base salary for this role will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, experience, and internal consistency.

If your salary requirements exceed the advertised range and you remain interested in Weiss-Aug, we encourage you to apply.

Weiss-Aug is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. Applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.

Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.

**What You’ll do as a Director Quality**
----------------------------------------

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:
 + Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
 + Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
 + Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
 + Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.
 + Drives targeted supplier quality improvement efforts and oversees supplier evaluation, approval, and control for assigned manufacturing sites.
 + Assists in the continuous improvement and standardization of quality system procedures and monitor effectiveness.
 + Supports the reliability function by integrating design for reliability tools and techniques within the local projects.
 + Leads quality planning efforts through cross-functional teaming at a site level.
* Supports the New Product/Service Development process and projects to ensure projects attain cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Directs local staff on planning sequential and concurrent quality activities. Establish planning and monitoring tools and techniques.
* Provides Quality viewpoints and opinions in planning and specifying existing and future products.
* Assists in the development of the Quality budget. Helps to ensures resources are adequate to fully support the Quality System.
* Takes ownership of all local quality issues, projects, and development activities. Works closely with the site’s Senior Management Teams to provide strategic direction and development of the manufacturing sites product quality strategies and tactics.
* Manages and provide direction to a teams of quality professionals both at corporate and manufacturing sites, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, appropriate staffing, and deployment of resources.
* Assures that local sites maintain and improve operational and quality systems to remain in a state of compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
* Works closely with the regulatory function to ensure compliance to appropriate ISO and FDA standards; plans for and assists in the management of external audits.
* Leads manufacturing and service site quality teams to ensure alignment to operations, support of Lean efforts and drive quality improvement performance for products, services, and processes across the sites.
* This individual has autonomy to perform the duties of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) on behalf of STERIS legal manufacturing entities under the EU MDR. This individual shall suffer no disadvantage within the organization in relation to proper fulfilment of his or her duties in lieu of article 15 of the EU MDR.

**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed**
------------------------------------------------

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering or related technical field)
* Minimum 10 years of experience with increased responsibility leading quality system and product quality improvement efforts. Exceptional leadership manifested through organizing and motivating teams toward their respective goals by employing hands-on management.
* Must fulfil the experience requirements listed in Article 15 of the EUMDR (PRRC).
* A solid quality foundation indicated by a demonstrated understanding of Lean/Six Sigma, quality system, and product/process improvement methodologies.
* Solid business acumen and proven ability to build and lead process and product improvement strategies and results.
* Strong expertise in analytical methods, quality systems, and continuous improvement methods.
* Excellent interpersonal, as well as verbal and written communication skills in order to develop and maintain rapport and effective internal and external relationships to support business success.
* The ability to work hard and deliver results under pressure, as well as the willingness to address and shift priorities in rapidly changing markets.

**Preferred:**

* Advanced degree.
* Experience with statistical analysis software and Visio.
* Experience in medical device industry.

**Other:**

* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Focus on identification of potential issues and continuous improvement.
* Experience working on cross-functional teams and on own initiative.
* Demonstrated excellent organizational, oral, and written communications skills.
* Must have PC experience, as well as working familiarity of desktop applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**What STERIS Offers**
----------------------

We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial future.

Here is a brief overview of what we offer:

 

* Market competitive pay
* Extensive paid time off and (9) added holidays
* Excellent healthcare, dental, and vision benefits
* Long/short term disability coverage
* 401(K) with company match
* Maternity and parental leave
* Additional add on benefits/discounts for programs such as pet insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and continued educational programs
* Excellent opportunities for advancement in a stable long-term career

#LI-HT

Pay range for this opportunity is $144,500.00 - $187,000.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.

Minimum pay rates offered will comply with county/city minimums, if higher than range listed. Pay rates are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to local labor market costs, years of relevant experience, education, professional certifications, foreign language fluency, etc.

STERIS offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits portfolio.

records.title: Director, Quality GxP Vendor Management & Audit Programs
records.description:
Description:

**The Company:**

This publicly held clinical-stage biotechnology company is focused on developing treatments for patients suffering from complex rare diseases using its novel cell penetrating peptide technology platform. Their lead product candidate, nomlabofusp, is a subcutaneously administered, recombinant fusion protein intended to deliver human frataxin (FXN), an essential protein to the mitochondria of patients with Friedreich’s ataxia. Friedreich’s ataxia is a rare, progressive, and fatal disease in which patients are unable to produce sufficient FXN due to a genetic abnormality.

The company has 80 employees and has assembled an experienced management team, each of whom has over 20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience. The management team, employees, and consultants have significant expertise in discovery, nonclinical and clinical development, regulatory affairs, commercialization, and the development of manufacturing processes utilizing good manufacturing practices (GMPs).

The company’s strategy is to become a leader in the treatment of rare diseases by leveraging their technology platform and applying their team’s know-how and expertise to the development of CTI-1601 and other future pipeline programs. They are best characterized by entrepreneurial and scientific leadership and a participatory workforce committed to success.

**Position Summary:**

The Director, GxP Vendor Management is responsible for leading Larimar’s GxP vendor management and audit programs and collaborating with key functional area stakeholders to ensure vendors are selected, qualified, managed and overseen in compliance with Larimar and regulatory requirements. This role owns the full vendor lifecycle and will shape the program’s strategy as Larimar seeks BLA approval, progresses with Phase 3 trial and plans for commercialization.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead and implement the strategic direction of the vendor management and audit programs at Larimar.
* Own the risk-based vendor qualification framework, including risk tiering and minimum oversight expectations for each tier, and manage day-to-day qualification activities through vendor audit and assessment, qualification, approval and filing of vendor-related qualification documentation.
* Maintain an approved vendor list and a master tracker of all GxP vendors (current, historic, and planned) as the single source of truth for vendor qualification/requalification, audit, and Quality Agreements.
* Partner with functional areas to develop and oversee execution of the risk-based annual external audit plan, including auditor assignments, audit tracking, follow up of audit responses and CAPAs, and filing of audit documentation.
* Manage the internal audit program including development and execution of internal audit plan to adequately assess Larimar’s internal processes.
* Manage the Quality Agreement program, including development and maintenance of Quality Agreements, and partner with Legal and functional areas to ensure Quality Agreements are in place and current with applicable vendors.
* Partner with functional areas to develop, review and maintain risk-based vendor oversight plans, including expectations for KPIs; governance meetings; issue escalation; oversight activities, frequency, responsibility, and documentation requirements; and verification that vendors and their subcontractors use qualified personnel.
* Conduct training on vendor management and audit programs to ensure functional areas understand and appropriately execute their responsibilities.
* Partner with functional areas to identify vendor deviations to assess issues potentially impacting the vendor qualification status or required oversight.
* Develop Vendor Management metrics, analyze vendor performance and compliance trends, and lead a periodic cross-functional vendor review that feeds into Quality Management Review.
* Ensure inspection readiness in the vendor management function and assist functional areas with readiness related to selection, qualification, management and oversight of their vendors.
* Evaluate and implement electronic vendor management systems, as applicable.

Requirements:

**Qualifications:**

* BS/BA in a life science or related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* 10+ years’ experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology industry, including at least 5 years leading vendor management/audit programs in a GxP environment.
* Expert knowledge of FDA, EMA, MHRA and ICH GxP regulations and guidelines, including ICH E6(R3) expectations for sponsor oversight of service providers.
* Strong GxP foundation associated with vendor oversight.
* Demonstrated experience planning and managing GxP vendor and internal audits, including follow up of audit responses and CAPAs.
* Experience developing and negotiating Quality Agreements with CROs, laboratories and other GxP service providers.
* Proficient with Veeva Systems, including Veeva Vault QualityDocs, desirable.
* Experience applying risk-based approaches to vendor tiering and oversight.
* Strong communication skills with all levels of the organization and external vendors, and the ability to influence functional areas without direct authority.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and strong verbal and writing skills.

**Benefits:**

Larimar Therapeutics offers all employees incentive stock options, a comprehensive benefits plan including 401K, and a flexible PTO policy.

***Equal Opportunity Employment***

*We are committed to equal-employment principles, and we recognize the value of committed employees who feel they are being treated in an equitable and professional manner. We strive to find ways to attract, develop and retain the talent needed to meet business objectives, and to recruit and employ highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities in which we live.*

*Employment policies and decisions on employment and promotion are based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. The decisions and criteria governing the employment relationship with all employees are made in a non-discriminatory manner—without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, military status, sexual orientation, or any other factor determined to be an unlawful basis for such decisions by federal, state, or local statutes.*

records.title: Director, Global Supply Chain Center of Excellence – Chemical Manufacturing

postedPay.title: Director, Global Supply Chain Center of Excellence – Chemical Manufacturing

records.description:
**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

**Position purpose**

 
 

Lead the global Supply Chain Center of Excellence across three pillars: Planning Excellence & Governance; Analytics, Optimization & Value Improvement; and Data, Systems & Digital Enablement.

 
 

Strengthen supply chain performance by establishing consistent planning practices, delivering actionable analysis and measurable improvements, and enabling reliable data and effective planning technology. Partner with regional supply chain leaders to build capabilities and sustain improvements while regional teams retain operational supply and inventory accountability.

 
 

**How you will thrive and create an impact**

 

**Planning Excellence & Governance**

* Establish global planning standards, business rules, decision rights, and exception thresholds.
* Define planning horizons, freeze rules, and handoffs between master supply planning, site scheduling, materials planning, and regional supply planning.
* Own S&OE/S&OP process design, calendars, review standards, and escalation methods.
* Establish Plan for Every Part (PFEP) standards and review methods for finished goods, raw materials, and packaging.
* Assess planning-process adoption and effectiveness, identify gaps, and lead improvements with regional owners.
* Build planner capabilities through training, coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

**Analytics, Optimization & Value Improvement**

* Establish common KPIs, dashboards, and performance-analysis methods across regions.
* Lead capacity scenarios and inventory modeling to support supply, working-capital, and investment decisions.
* Develop inventory policies, safety-stock methods, and replenishment recommendations with regional teams.
* Partner with Manufacturing and regional planning teams to improve capacity utilization, campaign planning, and planning parameters.
* Identify and quantify value leakage, including excess inventory, expiry, write-offs, premium freight, and avoidable expediting.
* Develop prioritized improvement initiatives with clear business cases, accountable execution owners, and milestones.
* Track corrective actions and validate realized benefits with Finance, distinguishing recurring savings, cash release, and cost avoidance.

**Data, Systems & Digital Enablement**

* Establish master-data standards, business ownership, validation controls, and data-quality remediation processes.
* Prioritize SAP planning gaps and configuration issues and lead business resolution with IT.
* Lead the business workstream for planning system implementation and SAP integration, including requirements, data readiness, testing, and deployment readiness.
* Advance reporting and workflow automation to improve planning productivity and exception management.
* Develop AI-enabled reporting, exception insights, and commentary with appropriate validation and accountable business review.
* Lead planner training, system adoption, and post-implementation improvement.
* Maintain a technology roadmap aligned with planning needs and measurable business outcomes.

**Leadership and cross-functional alignment**

* Set a balanced CoE roadmap across the three pillars, prioritizing resources against business needs.
* Lead and develop the CoE team with clear responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Partner with regional supply chain leaders, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Finance, and IT to implement improvements.
* Communicate progress, risks, benefits, and decisions required to supply chain leadership.
 

 

**Measures of success**

 
 

**Planning excellence**

* Adoption and effectiveness of planning standards, PFEP reviews, and S&OE/S&OP processes.
* Improved planning discipline, handoffs, and planner capability.

**Analytics and improvement**

* Quality and use of analysis in business decisions.
* Inventory and capacity improvements delivered with regional teams.
* Reduction in value leakage and Finance-validated benefits.

**Data and digital enablement**

* Planning-data accuracy and closure of critical data issues.
* Delivery and adoption of SAP, Netstock, and automation improvements.
* Measurable improvements in planning productivity and decision support.
 

 

**What we're looking for**

 
 

**Required**

* Typically 10 or more years of progressive supply chain experience, including team leadership and cross-functional improvement.
* Strong knowledge of master planning, capacity planning, inventory management, PFEP, and S&OE/S&OP.
* Demonstrated experience establishing planning governance and delivering measurable operational improvements.
* Proven leadership of teams and large, complex transformation programs across multiple sites or regions.
* Strong track record leading planning-system implementations, organizational change, training, and sustained adoption.
* Deep SAP planning expertise, including master-data governance and configuration, sufficient to guide business design and challenge technical solutions.
* Strong analytical judgment, with experience directing BI reporting, dashboards, and optimization initiatives to improve business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, establish planning governance, and deliver measurable operational and financial results.

 

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Chemicals or batch/process manufacturing experience.
* Experience leading a global-scale CoE or planning transformation.
* SAP and Netstock or comparable planning-platform experience.
* ASCM/APICS certification, Lean Six Sigma qualification, or an advanced degree.

 

**Disclaimer:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.
 
 
**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

The Plant Manager directs overall plant operations and the retail store ensuring the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with the company quality standards and customer delivery requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

1. Prioritize, schedule and delegate work assignments and directly supervise the plant staff to ensure the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with company quality requirements.

2. Monitor suppliers to ensure that they efficiently and effectively provide needed goods or services within budgetary limits.

3. Direct or coordinate financial or budget activities to fund operations, maximize investments, or increase efficiency.

4. Evaluate, recommend, and implement improvements in methods and processes to increase productivity and quality.

5. Develop plans for the maximum utilization of materials, machines and employees.

6. Review production costs and product quality; modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of division.

7. Ensure proper maintenance of equipment and building and establish plant housekeeping standards.

8. Develop and recommend plant capital and operating budgets to ensure conformance to budgets.

9. Develop policies and procedures to ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental and various regulatory agencies.

10. Enforce safety and work rules and company housekeeping standards.

11. Recommend locations for new facilities or oversee the remodeling or renovating of current facilities.

12. Ensure compliance with all quality, SQF, HACCP, safety, and sanitation regulations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage supervisors who supervise employees in the manufacturing of company products. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

 **Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Requires a bachelor's degree in production and operations management from a four-year college or university plus a minimum of five years progressively responsible related experience; or ten years progressively responsible related experience; or a combination of education and experience. Requires the ability to operate a computer and

standard office machines. Requires a general knowledge of company products and procedures. Requires a working knowledge of accounting methods and cost control procedures.

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret blueprints, customer specifications, general business periodicals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as algebraic formulas, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Wear required safety equipment when on shop floor. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects, tools, or controls. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

 **Additional Information**

*The hiring range for this role is $135,000 - $145,000 yearly**. Actual wages will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**: 
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:** 
Jack Link’s provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

**E-VERIFY:** 
Jack Link’s is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For information about the E-Verify program, please visit: http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

records.description:
Overview:

**Hospital Name:** Kessler Institute for Rehabilitation 
**Position:** Director of Plant Operations 
**Location:** Jersey City, NJ

**Compensation**: $90,000 to $145,000 *(Based on years of experience)*

Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas.

**We support your career growth and personal well-being:**

* **Start Strong:** Extensive and thorough orientation program to ensure a smooth transition into our setting
* **Your Health Matters**: Comprehensive medical/RX, health, vision, and dental plan offerings
* **Recharge & Refresh:** Generous PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance
* **Invest in Your Future:** Company-matching 401(k) retirement plan, as well as life and disability protection
* **Your Impact Matters:** Join a team of over 44,000 nationwide committed to providing exceptional care

Responsibilities:

The DPO is a member of the hospital leadership team who works in collaboration with the chief executive officer (CEO) to support the overall operation of the facility, inclusive of administrative and technical operation. Serving as the hospital’s safety officer, the DPO manages the environmental services and security departments to ensure safe operating conditions in compliance with all state, federal and accrediting agencies.

In this role, you are responsible for overseeing all aspects of the maintenance of the facility and grounds, the provision of utilities, the restoration and renovation of the facility and new construction.

* Planning, directing, and supervising all administrative and technical aspects of the department.
* Developing, reviewing, and managing the activities of self and other personnel in the department.
* Actively participating in all hospital committees which impact this department, with specific responsibility on the Safety and Infection Control Committees.
* Establishing and maintaining a Quality Control Program.
* Responsible for maintaining and Environment of Care and OSHA standards in accordance current Federal, State and local standards, guidelines and regulations.

 
Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements:

* Minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience in provision of maintenance, environmental services, and related services in a hospital environment required.
* Knowledge of JCAHO/OSHA regulations and standards required.

Preferred qualifications that will make you successful:

* College Degree related to building construction and maintenance preferred.

Additional Data:

*Equal Opportunity Employer/including Disabled/Veterans*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Position Description:**

* The Plant Manager is responsible for assisting the Director of Plant Services in engineering, custodial, and minor maintenance at selected facilities as assigned by the Director of Plant Services by starting, stopping, and observing all equipment that is interconnected with the air conditioning and/or heating system, safety, security, cleanliness, and the entire appearance at various facilities.
* The position can require extend or on call work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety or operational routine.

**Scope of Responsibility:**

* Opens building in morning; secures building in afternoon.
* Operates heating and air conditioning systems.
* Sees that rooms are properly ventilated.
* Replaces light globes or fluorescent tubes.
* Receives supplies, checks inventory requesting janitorial supplies; supplies custodial staff. Do not supply to cafeteria or stadium.
* Reports vandalism immediately to principal and keeps reports.
* Checks firefighting equipment and playground equipment for good functioning and safety.
* Repairs, removes or secures any unsafe equipment, reports same to principal.
* Cuts and maintains school yard and shrubs, watering regularly.
* Removes trash and debris from premises.
* Buffs floor when appropriate.
* Maintains cleanliness of halls and entrances during the day.
* Cleans classroom units as specified in accordance with work schedule and specified school needs.
* Is available for school and school sponsored activities. Outside agencies will pay for use of building as prescribed in policy manual.
* Sets up for assemblies, conferences, plays, programs when required.
* Supervises custodial staff, inspects their work, assigns duties, keeps and reports the time for himself/ herself and personnel, etc. in coordination with principal.
* Light maintenance functions, makes minor repairs such as replacing faucet handles, light switches, door knobs and door adjustments, glass repairs, painting, etc. for all buildings on school plant.
* Responsible to carry and answers system issued iPhone before, during and after normal work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety or operational routine.
* Maintains files and operates computer and other machines.
* Performs other duties as assigned by the Director of Plant Services.

**Skills and Qualifications:**

* We seek detail-oriented, independent self-starters who demonstrate an unwavering commitment to raising student achievement and who have a record of high performance in challenging situations.
* Successful candidates will also demonstrate and/or possess:
* 3+ years of progressively increasing experience custodial services.
* Strong communication skills in multiple settings and the ability to be an engaging change agent and culture creator that can inspire and motivate.
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to use quantitative and qualitative data to make decisions and recommendations.
* Collaborative management style, with a proven track record of working with diverse individuals at all levels to drive decision-making and results.
* Maintain a valid Louisiana drivers’ license.
* Have knowledge of driving laws, interpreting traffic signals, signs.
* Ability to operate a manual transmission.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED/Hi Set
* Two years of experience in a mechanical trade.
* Two years of college with 48 credit hours earned.

**Physical Involvement:**

* Walking and carrying tools, equipment, building materials, etc. are constant, everyday requirements.
* Surfaces vary including mud conditions after a rain, gravel, concrete, dirt, grass, etc.
* Climbing 6, 8, 10, and 12 foot step ladder, extension ladder, stairs and scaffolding are routinely required.
* This climbing often includes carrying of tools, building materials, etc.
* Trunk flexion and squatting are necessary requirements in accomplishing tasks such as working under raised buildings, in attic spaces, toilet room enclosures, etc., again often necessitating carrying tools, building materials, etc.
* Lifting is required daily in accomplishing tasks.
* Building materials, electrical panels, small generator and pump equipment, desks, full mop buckets, etc., are necessarily moved, in some cases loaded and unloaded from vehicles.
* Fifty pounds is the maximum expected load for one person.
* Two and three person coordinated lifting is occasionally required.

**Compensation:**

* JPS offers a competitive salary that is commensurate with experience.
* JPS also offers a competitive benefits package.

records.description:
Overview:

Are you an experienced **Director of Plant Operations and Environmental Services** seeking a rewarding career that aligns with your lifestyle? Look no further than PAM Health, where we are proud to offer competitive rates and an extensive benefits package designed to suit your needs. *Prefer candidate to live on the East Coast as this role will be supporting Florida- to Massachusetts.*

**What can PAM Health offer you?**

* **Patient-Centric Focus:** Join a hospital dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care and achieving the highest levels of patient satisfaction.
* **Career advancement:** Unlock opportunities for professional growth through our Education Advancement Program
* **Competitive compensation:** Explore our rates and take advantage of a comprehensive benefits package.
 + Medical Benefits: EPO/HDHP/HSA options; including prescription coverage, RX ‘n go, and Teladoc
 + Comprehensive dental and vision
 + Employee Assistance Program, including counseling, legal, and financial services
 + Flexible spending (FSA) and health savings (HAS) accounts
 + Life and Disability insurance benefits
 + Education/In-Service Opportunities including continuing education and tuition services
 + Supplemental benefits: Accident, critical illness, cancer, pet, and identity theft protection insurance options
 + Personal Travel Discounts
 + 401(k) plans and discretionary employer match
 + Generous Paid Benefit Time

Responsibilities:

* Manage Plant Operations, Maintenance, Environmental Services, Safety, and Security activities within established standard and Guidelines, PAM Health Policies and procedures, and budgetary limitations.
* Conduct inspections and maintain the facility and equipment to ensure that all aspects of the environment of Care, Life Safety Code, and interim Life Safety Code are achieved.

Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* Community electrical maintenance license if required.
* Certified Healthcare Facility Manager (CHFM) certification desired.
* Minimum of five years of related experience required.
* Hospital maintenance experience required.
* Must be familiar with JACHO, NFPA, & OSHA regulations.

About PAM Health:

**PAM HEALTH (PAM)** based in Enola, Pennsylvania, provides specialty healthcare services through more than 80 locations, as well as wound clinics and outpatient physical therapy locations, in 17 states. PAM Health is committed to providing high-quality patient care and outstanding customer service, coupled with the loyalty and dedication of highly trained staff, to be the most trusted source for post-acute services in every community it serves. Its mission is to serve people by providing compassionate, expert care, and to support recovery through education and research. Joining our PAMily allows you to work in a collaborative environment with colleagues and leadership with exposure to a variety of patient care levels. Aside from our competitive pay, generous paid benefit time, and excellent insurance options, you will also have opportunities for professional growth through our Education Advancement Program. We are excited to learn more about you and hope that you consider joining us on a shared mission to improve the lives of others by being an integral part of our We Care Program. Please take a moment to visit us online at **www.PAMHealth.com** for a comprehensive look at how we're able to positively impact our local communities.

PAM Health does not discriminate and does not permit discrimination, including, without limitation, bullying, abuse or harassment, on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or HIV status, or based on association with another person on account of that person's actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or HIV status.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
We are seeking a skilled Plant Manager to oversee our co-manufacturing operations. The Plant Manager will be responsible for managing all aspects of plant operations while ensuring efficient production processes and maintaining high standards of quality and safety. This role requires strong leadership abilities, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of manufacturing operations in a co-manufacturing setting.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Operational Leadership: Lead day-to-day plant operations, including production, packaging, maintenance, and quality control, to achieve production targets and quality standards.
* Team Management: Supervise and mentor a team of managers, supervisors, technicians, and support staff, fostering a culture of safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Production Planning: Develop and implement production schedules and resource allocation plans to optimize efficiency and meet customer demand while minimizing costs.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure adherence to quality assurance protocols and regulatory requirements, implementing corrective actions as needed to address non-conformities and improve processes.
* Safety and Compliance: Maintain a safe working environment by enforcing safety policies and procedures, conducting regular safety audits, and promoting a culture of safety awareness among employees.
* Budget and Cost Control: Manage plant budget and expenses effectively, identifying opportunities for cost savings and implementing measures to improve operational efficiency.
* Supplier and Customer Relations: Collaborate with suppliers and co-manufacturing partners to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods, and build strong relationships with customers to understand their needs and preferences.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, such as Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies, to streamline processes, reduce waste, and enhance overall plant performance.

records.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Quality
records.description:
**About the role:**
===================

This is a hands-on role with both strategic and executional scope. You will build and lead quality assurance and quality control standards across Operations, set the sampling, validation, and escalation practices the organization runs on, and partner closely with the Senior Manager, Operations - Payer Ops, the Human-in-the-Loop Operations leader, Product, and Engineering. You will report to the Head of Operations and help define the company's AI/Human QA strategy as Adonis scales.

**What you'll do:**
===================

**Own the Quality Program across Operations**
---------------------------------------------

* Define and own QA/QC standards, sampling methodologies, audit practices, and validation processes across AI agent outputs, human-executed work, and vendor-delivered operations.
* Develop & present quarterly plans and operating metrics; communicate progress and trade-offs; surface risks early + Work closely with the Head of Operations on strategic projects
* Lead quality assurance for payer workflows and agent outcomes, including new payer activations on the voice channel.
* Lead the development and implementation of a near-real-time QA Dashboard to provide visibility into quality, identify performance gaps, and track improvement over time.
* Partner with the operations team and external vendors to ensure work consistently meets Adonis's accuracy, operational, and compliance standards.
* Partner closely with the operations team to align on quality standards, remediation priorities, and operational performance.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to address quality gaps, improve workflows, and support strategic initiatives.
* Serve as the quality subject matter expert across Operations, ensuring quality considerations are incorporated into new workflows, product launches, and operational changes.

**Turn quality findings into operational and product improvements**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

* Translate and present quality trends and findings into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Operations, driving improvements from identification through implementation and validation.
* Leverage AI, automation, and internal tooling to increase the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of QA/QC processes.
* Establish quality thresholds and escalation criteria for uncertain, complex, or high-impact outcomes.

**Build and lead a high-performing quality function**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Build and scale the Quality function, establishing clear goals, ownership, processes, and performance metrics.
* Lead, coach, and develop onshore and offshore team members, as the function grows.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, training materials, and quality guidelines to support operational consistency and continuous improvement.

**Who you are:**
================

* 6+ years of experience
* Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) is required, with practical understanding of payer, claims, or related revenue-cycle workflows.
* Experience building or leading quality assurance, quality control, or quality programs in a technology-enabled operations environment.
* Experience coaching a team and creating clarity across multiple workstreams.
* Experience defining operating standards, evaluating results, investigating failures, and ensuring corrective actions are effective.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and operational partners.
* Comfort moving between strategic planning and hands-on operational detail in a fast-changing environment.
* An AI-forward mindset and practical experience applying AI, automation, or intelligent tooling to improve quality and operational performance, with sound judgment about when human review is needed.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to base salary, we also offer competitive equity and benefits packages.

**About Adonis**
================

Adonis is the leading AI orchestration platform for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), purpose-built for healthcare organizations seeking to transform their revenue operations. Traditional RCM processes often struggle with inefficiencies, costing providers up to 15% or more of their potential revenue. Through advanced automation, data science, and AI Agents, Adonis helps revenue teams detect vulnerabilities, optimize workflows, and deploy precise solutions that drive reliable and scalable financial outcomes.

Adonis is headquartered in New York City and has raised over $95M in funding, including a recent $40M Series C round led by Quadrille Capital with continued support from existing investors such as General Catalyst and Bling Capital. This funding supports our mission to restore sanity to RCM and equip provider groups and health systems with AI-driven revenue cycle operations at scale.

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

Actual base pay will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Adonis determines compensation based on each candidate’s experience and qualifications relative to peers, and most new hires fall near the middle of the range. In addition to base salary, you’ll receive meaningful equity and great benefits.

**Perks at Adonis**
===================

* Competitive equity packages
* Employer-paid medical insurance
* Employer-paid dental insurance
* Employer-paid vision insurance
* Employer-funded HSA
* Parental leave
* Commuter benefits
* Office lunches every day
* Office snacks
* Generous PTO
* Located in 3 World Trade Center with easy access to all trains and the PATH, and amazing views of the city

Adonis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Adonis, we fully comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals.

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K
