records.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team**,** fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture! 
Site: www.ptcbio.com

**Job Description Summary:**
----------------------------

The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP) is responsible for managing GxP Quality Assurance (QA) functions with an emphasis on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance for development products. This involves engaging and collaborating with cross-functional internal and external teams to evaluate processes, procedures, and activities for adherence to relevant industry standards, regulatory guidelines, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
The incumbent will support and/or conduct internal and external GCP audits of investigator sites, vendors, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, and submission documents, etc.
 
 
She/He will assist in inspection readiness activities. 
 
She/He may manage direct reports. 
 
The incumbent works cross-functionally with internal departments and external resources on GxP QA related issues.
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance – GxP (GCP)supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

*Responsibilities:*

* Partners with Clinical Development/Operations and actively participates in clinical study teams to ensure GCP compliance. Assists in identifying and communicating clinical trial-related risks and opportunities for process improvement. Reviews study-related documents and plans.
* Performs internal and external audits as assigned to ensure compliance with GXP regulations and guidelines.
* Communicates audit results to internal stakeholders and writes audit report.
* Assesses audit responses and ensures closure of corrective action preventative actions (CAPAs).
* Leads backroom activities during regulatory authority inspections and assists with GxP inspection readiness activities.
* Supports Quality Management System (QMS) including, but not be limited to, the following activities:
* QA review/approval of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.
* Drafts, reviews, and approves SOPs.
* May manage, coach, and mentor direct reports.
Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management. 

 

*Qualifications:*

Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance or related role in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related environment.

* Detailed knowledge and understanding of GCP regulations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and/or conducting QA audits.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal staff as well as with external, third-party vendors.
* Demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring direct reports.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency inspections.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
* Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

*Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.*

* Experience writing and reviewing SOPs.
* Clinical lab experience.

* Registered GxP Quality Assurance Certifications.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) inspections.
* Knowledge and experience in Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and/or Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) regulations.

*Travel requirements: Up to 30% (Domestic and International)*

*Expected Base Salary Range: $141,900 -$175,000. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.*

*In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans*

**EEO Statement:**

**PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.**

records.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

 

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

 

We are looking for a S **r. Manager, Quality** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to **Director of Quality** and based in **Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week** .

 

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.

* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.

* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.

* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.

* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.

* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.

* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.

* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.

* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.

* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.

* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.

* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.

* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.

* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.

* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)

* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.

* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.

* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.

* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.

* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.

* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.

* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.

* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.

* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.

* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

 

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .

* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.

* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up

* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.

* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)

* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)

* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.

* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.

* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.

* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.

* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.

* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.

* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).

* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.

* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.

* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.

* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.

* Possess a passion for excellence.

* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.

* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.

* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

 

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

 

At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

**Salary Ranges:**
==================

$149,300.00 - $214,700.00

records.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering

postedPay.title: Senior Director, Automation & New Process Engineering

records.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Overview**
---------------------

TransMedics is seeking a **Senior Director of Automation and New Process Engineering** to lead a critical transformation within our R&D and Engineering organization. This highly visible leadership position will oversee Automation, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Sustaining Engineering, driving engineering innovation, manufacturing excellence, and operational scalability.

**This is a build role, not a maintain role.**

As TransMedics continues its rapid growth, we need a strategic, hands-on engineering leader who can develop and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap while remaining closely connected to day-to-day manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in automation and advanced manufacturing with proven experience building high-performing engineering organizations. This leader will drive improvements in product quality, reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability while developing the engineering talent needed to support our continued growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead the Automation, New Product Introduction, and Sustaining Engineering organizations.
* Develop and execute a multi-year engineering transformation strategy aligned with business growth.
* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Establish organizational structures, processes, and capabilities to support long-term scalability.
* Oversee performance management, professional development, and engineering resource planning.

**Automation & Advanced Manufacturing**

* Drive the implementation of advanced automation, robotics, and innovative manufacturing technologies.
* Lead automation initiatives across multiple manufacturing lines to improve quality, efficiency, and throughput.
* Identify opportunities to modernize manufacturing processes, systems, and infrastructure.
* Establish scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.

**New Product Introduction & Sustaining Engineering**

* Provide strategic leadership for NPI engineering and manufacturing process development.
* Ensure successful transitions from product development into scalable manufacturing.
* Lead sustaining engineering initiatives to improve existing products and manufacturing processes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and support product launches.
* Maintain a hands-on approach to troubleshooting manufacturing issues and addressing production or launch risks.

**Design for Excellence (DfX)**

* Champion Design for Excellence (DfX), including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Drive product and process simplification, including part-count reduction.
* Improve product reliability, manufacturing efficiency, and cost effectiveness through engineering design improvements.
* Establish best practices supporting consistent, scalable manufacturing performance.

**Strategic Collaboration & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering systems, processes, and infrastructure.
* Leverage manufacturing technologies, digital tools, and operational data to improve engineering outcomes.
* Support capital planning, resource allocation, and strategic investment decisions.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience specifying, developing, and implementing automation across multiple manufacturing lines.
* Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes, automation technologies, and engineering operations.
* Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on technical problem-solving.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree.
* Proven success leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth or transformation.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies, including robotics and automated production systems.
* Strong understanding of Design for Excellence (DfX) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks, quality systems, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leveraging Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Demonstrated financial acumen, capital planning, project management, and resource allocation experience.
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

records.title: Director, Program Operations
records.description:
In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's Processing Technologies business unit. This role serves as the primary conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

This role is on site at one of the following Mercury facilities: **Hudson NH, Phoenix AZ**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of OPMs and MPMs accountable for operational aspects of program life cycle from proposal, development, production, sustainment, & delivery.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the line of business and operations, communicating customer requirements that affect manufacturing and supply chain execution.
* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.
* Support and present operations metrics and data through program reviews (both internal and external) to Mercury and customer leadership.
* Champion efforts to meet readiness requirements throughout an NPI stage-gate process.
* Change leader, helping to drive Mercury's strategy, structure, and values.
* Strategic thinking coupled with ROI / business case development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* Typically requires 10+ years prior relevant experience in functional areas of Supply Chain, Operations (including Production Control), Program Management, or technical Project Management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience providing input into and reviewing EACs, along with development of business cases.
* Experience in review and understanding of Statements of Work (SOW) and project requirements (technical and commercial).
* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-starter, capable of achieving organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management and external stakeholders.
* Ability to succeed in fast paced, developmental environment.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to assign the appropriate priorities to the many tasks that need to be performed.
* Knowledge of US Government acquisition laws and regulations (FAR).
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP business systems.
* Knowledge of Mercury-type products.

**Why should you join Mercury Systems?**

Mercury Systems is a technology company that makes the world a safer, more secure place. We push processing power to the tactical edge, making the latest commercial technologies profoundly more accessible for today's most challenging aerospace and defense missions. From silicon to system scale, Mercury enables customers to accelerate innovation and turn data into decision superiority. Headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, Mercury employs more than 2,300 people in 24 locations worldwide. To learn more, visit mrcy.com

**Our Culture**

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. We value communication and transparency, and strive to foster two-way dialogue at all levels of the organization. We are committed to lifelong learning, offering comprehensive skills training and tuition reimbursement. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or you are an experienced professional, it's important to us that you feel recognized and rewarded for your contributions.

To find out more about Why Mercury?, or visit the Mercury Community or find answers to general questions at Mercury FAQs

records.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

 

JT05

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

records.title: Director, Central Laboratory Operations
records.description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE

 

* Builds and leads Takeda’s new Central Laboratory Operations group, defining the vision, operating model, organizational design, capabilities, and ways of working required to deliver enterprise technical and operational oversight of central laboratory services across global clinical development programs.
* Establishes the foundational infrastructure for central laboratory oversight, including processes, vendor strategy, systems, and metrics, so that central laboratory solutions are technically sound, operationally executable, globally compliant, and inspection-ready from study design through database lock and study closeout.
* Provides leadership of the Sample Management group, ensuring its in-trial activities interface effectively with central laboratory operations. Biorepository and biobank activities are out of scope for this role.
* Partners with Clinical Science, Clinical Operations, Translational Medicine, Translational Biomarkers and Bioanalytics, Data Management, Biometrics, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Procurement, and external laboratory providers to deliver consistent, scalable central laboratory capabilities across the portfolio.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

 

**Building the Central Laboratory Operations Group (primary focus)**

* Define and execute the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap to stand up the Central Laboratory Operations group, including mission, scope, service model, phased capability build, and measures of success.
* Design the organizational structure, roles, and resourcing plan; recruit, onboard, develop, and lead a high-performing team of central laboratory technical and operational experts.
* Establish the central laboratory operating model and oversight framework, including standards, decision rights (RACI), governance forums, escalation pathways, and interfaces with Clinical Operations, Translational Medicine, Translational Biomarkers and Bioanalytics, Data Management, Biometrics, Quality, and Procurement.
* Develop the foundational processes, SOPs, work instructions, templates, and training needed to standardize central laboratory startup, conduct, and closeout across studies, and transition existing study-level central laboratory activities into the new group without disruption to ongoing studies.
* Develop the business case, budget, and resource forecasts for the group, and secure leadership alignment and sponsorship for the phased build-out.
* Lead the central laboratory vendor strategy, including evaluation, selection, and qualification of central laboratories and will consult in evaluation and selection of specialty laboratories as appropriate, technical capability assessments, quality and compliance reviews, contracting input with Procurement, service-level expectations, KPIs, issue escalation, and ongoing vendor governance.
* Provide technical oversight during clinical development planning and protocol design by assessing laboratory feasibility, test menus, specimen requirements, reference ranges, turnaround times, and the operational impact of study endpoints and schedules.
* Establish central laboratory systems and data capabilities, including laboratory information management systems, electronic data capture interfaces, data transfer specifications, edit checks, result reconciliation, traceability, and data readiness for analysis, database lock, and regulatory submission.
* Build quality and regulatory compliance into the group from inception, including ICH-GCP, applicable GCLP principles, CLIA/CAP or equivalent laboratory requirements, data integrity, inspection readiness, audits, deviations, CAPAs, and vendor change controls. Lead IVDR requirements for each protocol.
* Establish portfolio-level central laboratory metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting for quality, timeliness, cost, risk, capacity, data delivery, and vendor performance; use trends and root-cause analysis to drive risk mitigation and sustained improvement.
* Drive modernization through standardized processes, automation, digital integration, data analytics, and emerging laboratory technologies as the group matures.

**Sample Management Group Oversight**

* Provide leadership of the Sample Management group, including setting priorities, allocating resources, approving goals, and supporting talent development; day-to-day sample management execution remains with the Sample Management lead.
* Define the handoffs between central laboratory operations and sample management (e.g., laboratory manuals, collection kits, sample shipment to central laboratories) so roles, responsibilities, and escalation paths are clear.
* Ensure appropriate sample management resourcing and integration at the study level to ensure end-to-end sample mgmt support during study conduct
* Serve as the senior escalation point for sample-related issues that affect central laboratory testing, study timelines, or data quality.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Clinical Laboratory Science, Biomedical Science, Pharmacy, or a related field; advanced

degree such as MS, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent is preferred.

* 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, central laboratory, diagnostic laboratory, or other regulated life-

sciences environment, with significant leadership responsibility for global clinical laboratory delivery.

* Proven track record of building a new function, team, or capability from the ground up, including defining strategy, operating

model, organizational design, processes, and governance.

* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including recruiting, developing, and managing teams and overseeing managers in

a matrixed global environment.

* Strong technical knowledge of central and specialty laboratory operations, service models, test menus, analytical platforms,

specimen requirements, reference intervals, laboratory workflow controls, and fit-for-purpose testing within clinical

development.

* Experience selecting, qualifying, contracting with, and governing global central laboratory vendors, including KPI/SLA

management, issue escalation, audits, CAPAs, and continuous improvement.

* Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, applicable GCLP principles, CLIA/CAP or equivalent laboratory standards, IVDR where

records.description:
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Directly Supervises: Executive Operations Coordinator, Administrative Manager, Administrative Assistants, Revenue Cycle Manager, Operations Manager, and other operational employees assigned by the Chief Executive Officer

Schedule: Full-time; 40 hours per week, with scheduling flexibility based on operational needs

Compensation: As stated in the signed offer or compensation agreement

Work Arrangement: Primarily remote, with weekly on-site presence required at Elevation's Homewood and Matteson offices

COMPENSATION AND HOURS

* This is a full-time, salaried-exempt position scheduled for 40 hours per week. The employee will receive the salary stated in the signed offer or compensation agreement and is not eligible for overtime compensation.

* If time reporting is required for attendance, workload, leave, or administrative purposes, the employee must accurately record actual hours worked. Time entries do not change the established salary.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Operations ensures that Elevation Individual & Family Therapy's administrative and operational functions are organized, accountable, compliant, and aligned with client-service and financial goals. The position reduces the CEO's involvement in routine operations by resolving matters within the role's authority, ensuring assigned work is completed, and presenting recommendations when executive approval is required.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

1. OPERATIONAL LEADERSHIP AND STAFF ACCOUNTABILITY

* Set priorities, deadlines, performance expectations, and coverage plans for assigned staff across both locations.

* Conduct regular supervision meetings and monitor attendance, responsiveness, accuracy, productivity, professionalism, and follow-through.

* Review required reports and promptly address missed deadlines, repeated errors, unresolved concerns, and incomplete work.

* Provide training, coaching, written expectations, and documented corrective feedback; coordinate performance improvement or disciplinary processes with the Executive Operations Coordinator and CEO.

* Assign each operational concern to an appropriate owner, monitor it through resolution, and escalate only matters requiring executive, legal, financial, clinical, or regulatory authority.

2. ADMINISTRATIVE AND CLIENT-SERVICE OPERATIONS

* Oversee phone and voicemail coverage, new-client inquiries, intake follow-up, insurance verification, required paperwork, scheduling, check-in, and appointment confirmation.

* Monitor re-engagement, no-show and cancellation outreach, copay collection, approved payment-plan workflows, and records requests.

* Ensure administrative staff consistently follow approved scripts, workflows, response-time standards, documentation requirements, and escalation procedures.

* Oversee office calendars, room assignments, supplies, equipment, routine facility concerns, and administrative coverage.

* Coordinate with clinical leadership when an operational concern affects client care, provider scheduling, documentation, or referrals.

3. REVENUE CYCLE OVERSIGHT

* Directly supervise the Revenue Cycle Manager, establish performance expectations, review results, provide coaching and accountability, and ensure timely follow-through on revenue-cycle priorities.

* Hold the Revenue Cycle Manager accountable for routine billing operations and supervision of assigned billing staff; coordinate cross-department priorities and escalate unresolved financial, payer, staffing, or compliance risks to the CEO.

* Review reports related to claims, denials, payment posting, insurance follow-up, patient balances, accounts receivable, and collections.

* Ensure billing concerns are assigned, documented, and resolved within established timelines.

* Identify administrative or clinical workflow failures that contribute to denials, delayed billing, inaccurate balances, or lost revenue.

* Coordinate communication among RCM, administrative, clinical, and collections staff and escalate material payer, financial, or compliance concerns.

4. POLICIES, SOPS, AND EHR WORKFLOW IMPROVEMENT

* Identify processes requiring a written policy, SOP, checklist, script, workflow, quality check, or escalation procedure.

* Draft and update operational policies and SOPs with the employees and subject-matter experts responsible for the work; coordinate approval by the appropriate leader.

* Maintain version control, review dates, distribution, training, employee acknowledgment, and monitoring of approved procedures.

* Evaluate EHR and technology workflows for intake, scheduling, documentation tracking, billing, records, client communication, and reporting.

* Identify duplicate entry, inconsistent data, preventable delays, and unnecessary manual work; recommend and coordinate approved templates, reports, alerts, tracking tools, automations, and vendor requests.

* Test approved changes, document the revised workflow, coordinate staff training, and monitor implementation while protecting confidentiality and system access.

5. HR, CREDENTIALING, AND COMPLIANCE COORDINATION

Directly supervise the Executive Operations Coordinator by establishing priorities, monitoring deadlines and accuracy, reviewing performance, and ensuring timely completion of assigned HR administration, credentialing, compliance, records, onboarding, offboarding, and policy-related responsibilities. The Executive Operations Coordinator or other assigned personnel retain responsibility for completing the detailed administrative work and maintaining required records.

* Ensure employee performance, attendance, conduct, onboarding, offboarding, training, personnel documentation, and policy-acknowledgment processes are coordinated appropriately and escalated to the CEO when executive authority or protected reporting is required.

* Review credentialing, recredentialing, payer enrollment, licensure, renewal, training, and compliance trackers; ensure assigned staff follow up on incomplete or at-risk items.

* Coordinate provider status changes with HR, billing, clinical leadership, scheduling, and provider-directory workflows.

* Monitor completion of corrective actions and escalate material delays, expirations, privacy concerns, payer or government inquiries, suspected fraud, client-safety issues, or other significant risks immediately.

* Support audits, internal reviews, payer requests, and corrective-action plans without acting as Elevation's attorney or sole clinical compliance authority.

6. BUDGET AND EXPENSE MONITORING

* Assist the CEO with preparing and monitoring approved administrative and operational budgets.

* Review actual operational expenses against approved amounts, including administrative and billing staffing costs, overtime, office supplies, software subscriptions, vendor charges, and upcoming renewals.

* Identify unusual spending, recurring overages, duplicate services, avoidable expenses, and practical opportunities for cost savings.

* Coordinate with billing and collections personnel to identify preventable revenue leakage related to denials, delayed claims, workflow errors, missed collections, or unresolved client balances.

* Maintain organized records of approved operational purchases and recurring expenses and submit purchase or budget-adjustment requests with the cost, purpose, priority, and recommendation.

* Provide the CEO with a monthly summary of significant budget variances, anticipated expenses, and recommended corrective or cost-saving actions.

7. REPORTING AND LEADERSHIP COLLABORATION

* Provide a concise weekly CEO report covering accomplishments, unresolved matters, staff concerns, revenue cycle issues, credentialing/compliance risks, budget concerns, and policy, SOP, or EHR project status.

* Provide a monthly operational summary identifying trends, recurring problems, performance patterns, completed improvements, and recommended priorities.

* Present significant concerns with relevant facts, actions already taken, and a recommended solution rather than forwarding unorganized information.

* Directly supervise the Administrative Manager and Administrative Assistants. Establish priorities, monitor performance, and maintain formal accountability while using the Administrative Manager's workflow knowledge and assigned functional ownership to support training, quality, office operations, and consistent administrative processes.

8. GROWTH INITIATIVES AND PROGRAM IMPLEMENTATION

* Lead the operational assessment of CEO-directed growth opportunities, including new services, programs, partnerships, and location expansions. Work with clinical leadership, revenue cycle, and other relevant staff to assess demand, staffing, costs, reimbursement where applicable, space and technology needs, and implementation risks. Clinical leadership guides clinical program design.

* Present the CEO with a recommendation, estimated costs and resources, and a proposed timeline. The CEO decides which opportunities move forward.

* Lead the rollout of approved initiatives. Build the launch plan, assign responsibilities and deadlines, coordinate training and workflow changes, track milestones, and report progress and early results to the CEO.

ROLE BOUNDARIES AND DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY

The Director of Operations owns operational follow-through but does not personally perform every task within the functions overseen. The position may assign and prioritize routine work, require status updates, provide coaching and corrective feedback, implement approved procedures, coordinate across departments, and resolve routine administrative or client-service concerns within established policies.

CEO approval is required before hiring, termination, suspension, compensation changes, material policy changes, unapproved contracts or purchases, new recurring expenses, significant balance waivers, banking or debt decisions, public statements, or substantive responses to legal, government, payer, or regulatory matters. The Director of Operations monitors and recommends but does not replace bookkeeping, payroll, accounting, or executive financial authority.

SCHEDULE AND CAPACITY

* Periodic on-site presence at both Elevation offices is required to observe day-to-day workflows, the office environment, staff performance, client-service operations, and implementation of policies and procedures. The timing and frequency of visits will be based on operational needs and CEO direction.

* The regular schedule will be established by the CEO and will generally total 40 hours per week. Some evening or weekend work may be necessary based on operational needs. The employee must maintain agreed-upon availability during core business hours for supervision, meetings, and time-sensitive matters.

* Continuous after-hours availability is not expected; after-hours contact should generally be limited to urgent matters that cannot reasonably wait. Occasional schedule fluctuations do not change the position's established salary.

* The Director of Operations must notify the CEO when workload or competing priorities cannot reasonably be completed within the established 40-hour schedule and recommend what should be delegated, postponed, or reprioritized.

* Unless otherwise approved, the role should generally carry no more than two major operational improvement projects at one time. Major launches count toward this limit unless the CEO approves an exception.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* At least three years of relevant operations, healthcare administration, office management, or employee-supervision experience.

* Demonstrated ability to supervise employees, address performance concerns, analyze operational data, and independently move work to completion.

* Strong judgment, initiative, organization, problem-solving, discretion, emotional maturity, and written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to draft clear policies, SOPs, reports, checklists, and workflows and to protect confidential client, employee, financial, and business information.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, spreadsheets, cloud-based systems, and the ability to learn and improve EHR and business platforms.

* Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare confidentiality expectations; reliable transportation and ability to work from both Elevation locations as required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, management, human resources, or a related field; behavioral health or healthcare operations experience; and experience with revenue cycle, credentialing, compliance, EHR workflow improvement, SOP development, reporting, dashboards, or automations.

records.title: Director, Operational Excellence
records.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53235
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring an Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence for our highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and discipline. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence runs our site MDI (managing for daily improvements) OpEx, continuous improvement programs, and all site PMO operations owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio while coordinating cross-functional projects. They build the operating rhythm that turns discrete functions into one aligned site team as the site scales to six suites, and owns the site’s strategy, execution, and culture discipline planning. Lead executive-level investigations and special initiatives as project/program lead, absorbing crisis response so operational leaders can stay focused on daily management.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Run site MDI including ownership of the Tier 6 site critical issue forum, ensuring cross-functional blockers are surfaced and resolved quickly

* Establish and sustain the site's cadence of daily, weekly, and monthly forums so issues are raised and resolved at the right level

* Lead OpEx and continuous improvement programs, building and prioritizing a CI project pipeline and delivering realized savings

* Lead all site PMO activities, owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio, coordinating cross-functional projects and site initiatives and driving on-time delivery

* Own site strategy, execution, and rigor planning for culture translating strategic priorities into a disciplined, trackable execution plan across the site

* Own MDI and all standard work initiatives site-wide, ensuring consistent methodology and application across every function and suite

* Own site-wide implementation of lean principles building and driving the phased adoption roadmap across leadership, suites, and functions, from initial leadership alignment through daily floor-level practice

* Own site business analytics building and maintaining the reporting, dashboards, and KPI infrastructure that drive MDI, CI prioritization, and Site Leadership Team decision-making

* Co-lead the monthly finance/business review with finance operations, reconciling cost and capital needs against the site's financial plan

* Coach leaders and teams in Lean and problem-solving methods and build an OpEx culture across the site

* Embed MDI and OpEx practices as suites come online so new suites start up with the site's operating standards

* Partner with manufacturing, quality, technical services, technical operations, supply chain, and Finance as a member of the site leadership team

* Embed the digital and connected plant model in site MDI, using real-time data and digital tools for daily management and escalation

* Own the site's multi-year operational efficiency roadmap, driving leaner operations and delivering year-over-year efficiency gains

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing OpEx team; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Own a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Own these function's OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function
 

 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in engineering, life sciences, business or related technical field
* MBA & PMP certification preferred

* + Associate Director: 10+ years of operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 5+ years of progressive leadership

* + Director: 12+ years in operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 7+ years of progressive leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$150,800.00 - $292,700.00

records.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

postedPay.title: Supply Chain Director of Operational Excellence

records.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2655441 Hybrid 108400006 SC Administration Business & Administration PALO ALTO, 1840 Embarcadero, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

 
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.** 
 
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Supply Chain Operational Excellence is a senior leadership role driving enterprise‑wide efficiency, innovation, and transformation across a Gartner top‑2 ranked healthcare supply chain. With system‑wide influence and a seat at the leadership table, this role partners closely with the Chief Supply Chain Officer and Vice President of Strategic Initiatives to turn strategy into measurable results. The ideal candidate combines healthcare supply chain expertise with strong program management skills and a passion for developing people, leading change, and delivering measurable, enterprise‑wide impact. 
 
**Locations** 
Stanford Health Care 
 
**What you will do**

* Maintain continuous alignment with defined organizational and departmental strategic business objectives in conjunction with leadership.
* Direct and ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities of the team and ensure competency of all staff.
* Supports and partners on Change Management, Training and Communications activities as needed for effective performance improvement and project management.
* Act in an advisory capacity to all Supply Chain divisions, programs, staff and leaders.
* Provide expertise, guidance and training on Performance Improvement and Project Management best practices.
* Apply LEAN/Six Sigma principles and methods to identify waste reduction and performance optimization opportunities across Supply Chain operations.
* Implement, oversee and continuously improve Supply Chain systems, processes and standard work to drive the efficient management of operations across Logistics, Sourcing, Procurement, Business Office, Resiliency, Sustainability, Data Management and other functions.
* Build, develop and grow business relationships with Supply Chain’s key stakeholders and partners including but not limited to the Interventional Platform, A/P, Pharmacy, and IT.
* Lead cross-departmental initiatives, establishing strong governance, communication, and accountability to deliver progress measurable through mutually agreed KPIs.
* Align and collaborate with the enterprise Performance Improvement team and Stanford Operating System (SOS).
* Lead the implementation of programs and/or projects as assigned by the Administrative Director.

**Education Qualifications**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a work-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant experience in lieu of degree may be considered. Relevant experience in lieu of degree is in addition to the experience requirements for this position.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Seven (7) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Must have strong leadership and interpersonal skills and be effective at people management including the ability to delegate assignments and share decision-making with team members and direct reports as appropriate.
* Excellent communication skills including the ability to present, and to write in a clear and understandable manner.
* Ability to understand complex verbal or written instructions and translate to action to deliver quantitative and qualitative results.
* Must be well organized and systematic, and able to design, implement and maintain standard work processes.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies to lead complex project teams and large scope projects, including managing resources (people, costs, time).
* Familiar with and able to apply Lean Six Sigma concepts and techniques including value stream mapping, kaizen, Five Whys, VoC, RCA etc. for structured process improvement.
* Demonstrated expertise in leading change management initiatives within Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines. Knowledge of Supply Chain functions, practices, and operational challenges.
* Understanding of healthcare and clinical concepts.

**Licenses and Certifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Certification preferred .
* PMP - Project Mgmt Professional preferred .
* CMRP (Certified Materials & Resource Professionals) preferred.

**Physical Demands and Work Conditions** 
**Blood Borne Pathogens**

* Category II - Tasks that involve NO exposure to blood, body fluids or tissues, but employment may require performing unplanned Category I tasks

**These principles apply to ALL employees:** 
 
**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience** 
 
*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.* 
 
*You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

* Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
* Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
* Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

**Equal Opportunity Employer Stanford Health Care (SHC) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in****all of****its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.**

Base Pay Scale: Generally starting at $81.59 - $108.12 per hour

The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.
